events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has revealed the limits of US power and the rising geopolitical instability in the Middle East. events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased volatility in the markets, with emerging markets being particularly affected. The price of gold is expected to rise as a safe-haven asset.
